title: 文章复盘 · 8题
meta: 2014 英语一 Section I (Cloze) · 2026-10-20学习复盘 · 本篇问题 3 题 + 历史弱项 5 题 · 全部使用迁移语境
footer: 本轮结果被GitHub接收并经Actions核验后，才会进入后续间隔复习；未提交的浏览器作答只保存在本地。

questions.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

questions.q: The sensor readings are useful for tracking daily changes. ___, they are too imprecise to determine whether a bridge meets the safety limit. Which connector best links the two assessments?
o: For example
However
Similarly
Therefore

exp.trans: 这些传感器读数有助于追踪每日变化；然而，读数还不够精确，无法判断桥梁是否达到安全限值。
exp.structure: 首句主语The sensor readings，系表结构are useful；第二句they回指读数，too imprecise to determine说明精度限制。
exp.other: reading 读数；imprecise 不精确的；meet a limit 达到界限要求。
exp.meaning: 共同话题并不等于并列关系。第一句肯定一种用途，第二句限制另一种用途，因此用转折引出限定。
exp.rest: “例如”不能把不适用的用途当成前句有用的实例；“同样”忽略由肯定到限制的变化；“因此”错误地把精度不足说成有用的必然结果。

questions.q: After a week of poor sleep, her mental sharpness declined: she needed longer to notice mistakes in a familiar spreadsheet. What declined?
o: Her readiness to adopt a different working method.
Her willingness to persevere with a difficult task.
Her speed and accuracy in noticing relevant details.
Her freedom to choose which assignments to accept.

exp.trans: 一周睡眠不足后，她的思维敏锐度下降了：在熟悉的电子表格中发现错误也需要更久。
exp.structure: mental修饰sharpness；冒号后needed longer to notice mistakes解释这种能力下降的具体表现。
exp.other: sharpness 敏锐度；plasticity 可塑性；flexibility 灵活性；spreadsheet 电子表格。
exp.meaning: 敏锐度是及时捕捉、辨识信息的能力，不是可塑性、意志或选择自由。后文的表现帮助确定这个抽象名词的含义。
exp.rest: 采用新方法的意愿接近灵活性而非敏锐度；坚持意愿属于毅力；自主选择工作属于自由度，都不能解释发现熟悉表格中的错误变慢。

questions.skill: 避免把可能风险扩大成已经发生的事实
questions.q: A mountain road report says heavy snow can lead to closures, but today's bulletin only forecasts snow. Which conclusion is supported?
o: The road is closed today because heavy snow is forecast.
The forecast identifies a risk, not a confirmed closure today.
The road has remained open through every previous snowstorm.
The report proves that snow will not affect road access today.

exp.trans: 山区道路报告说，大雪可能导致封路，但今天的公告只是在预报降雪。最有根据的结论是：预报指出一种风险，并没有确认今天已经封路。
exp.structure: can lead to closures表达可能结果；today's bulletin only forecasts snow限制了当前已知事实。题干要求判断能得出什么结论，而不是推断可能后果已经发生。
exp.other: forecast 预报；closure 封路；confirmed 已确认的；road access 道路通行。
exp.meaning: 不能把条件性风险升级为已发生事件。可能导致封路，不等于今天已经封路；同样也不能反向断言降雪一定不会影响通行。
exp.rest: 预报降雪不等于已经封路；没有证据说明道路经历过所有以往的雪暴；报告指出风险，并没有证明雪不会影响通行。

questions.target: 动作的施事与作用方式
questions.skill: 动作的施事与作用方式
questions.q: A map display shows travel time and price side by side; passengers remain free to ignore it. Which sentence best describes the function the display provides?
o: It forces passengers to follow the cheapest route.
It allows passengers to compare the route options.
It requires passengers to book before comparing.
It expects all passengers to make the same choice.

exp.trans: 地图界面并列显示行程时间和价格，乘客可以不使用它。它的作用是让乘客能够比较方案，而不是强制某种选择。
exp.structure: shows的主语是display；remain free的主语是passengers。allow/force/require/expect都可接宾语加to不定式，须进一步辨别语义。
exp.other: allow 允许、使能够；force 强迫；require 要求；expect 期待；side by side 并列地。
exp.meaning: 中文“让”可能表示使能够或迫使，英语并不总用同一个动词。要看工具提供能力，还是主体施加强制要求。
exp.rest: 强迫走最便宜路线和要求先订票都增加了没有出现的限制；期待所有人同选也没有证据，且不能准确表述并列显示信息提供的比较能力。

questions.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
questions.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
questions.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

questions.q: The redesign owes its success not to a faster motor but to a simpler control panel. Which reading keeps the shared relation intact?
o: The faster motor owes its success to the control panel.
Success is credited to the panel rather than to the motor.
The simpler panel was made possible by the redesign's earlier success.
The sentence credits the motor and the panel equally.

exp.trans: 这次重新设计的成功不是由于更快的电机，而是由于更简单的控制面板。两个to短语共同说明同一个成功应归因于什么。
exp.structure: The redesign是主语，owes是谓语，its success是宾语。not to a faster motor和but to a simpler control panel是同层并列的归因补足语，都受owes its success支配。
exp.other: redesign 重新设计；owe A to B 把A归因于B；motor 电机；control panel 控制面板。
exp.meaning: 共享的是owe success to...的归因结构，不是让后半句生成新主语或改变成功的所属对象。not...but...排除电机、强调面板。
exp.rest: The faster motor owes...把电机改成主语并换掉success所属对象；panel was made possible...把面板作为成功的结果，反转因果；equally忽略not对电机解释的排除。

questions.skill: 作者立场 + do so 回指
questions.q: A transport ministry says that because it does not want to carry out Parliament's rail-safety plan, local councils should not be allowed to enforce it either. The court rejects this claim. What is best supported?
o: The court checks an executive attempt to extend power over local councils.
Parliament alone must enforce every rail-safety rule across all regions.
The ministry has unlimited control over local councils and their rules.
Local councils may ignore national rail-safety laws whenever they choose to do so.

exp.trans: 法院正在制衡行政部门试图扩大自身对地方议会的权力。
exp.structure: because引出交通部不愿执行议会计划的原因；should not be allowed...either表示它还想阻止地方执行；The court rejects this claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: carry out 执行；executive 行政部门；council 地方议会；reject a claim 驳回一种主张。
exp.meaning: 行政部门不愿执行议会的计划，不等于它可以阻止地方在法律允许范围内执行。法院驳回这种主张，体现对行政权的制衡。
exp.rest: 原文没有说所有铁路安全规则只能由议会执行；交通部并没有无限控制权；法院驳回行政部门的主张也不意味着地方可以无视所有国家法律。

relative.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

logic.q: The medicine must stay below 8°C; it may lose effectiveness ___ it is kept in a refrigerator during transport.
o: because
unless
although
so that

exp.trans: 这种药必须保持在8摄氏度以下；运输途中如果不放在冰箱里，它可能会失去药效。
exp.structure: 分号前：The medicine（主语）+ must stay（谓语）+ below 8°C（补足信息）。分号后主干：it（主语）+ may lose（谓语）+ effectiveness（宾语）。unless引导条件状语从句：it is kept in a refrigerator during transport，相当于 if it is not kept...。
exp.other: effectiveness 有效性；refrigerator 冰箱；during transport 在运输过程中；keep sth below... 使某物保持在……以下。
exp.meaning: unless = if...not，表示“除非/如果不”。这里逻辑是：不冷藏 → 可能失效。
exp.rest: because表示原因，会变成“因为被冷藏所以失效”，逻辑相反；although表示让步，不能表达必要条件；so that表示目的/结果，通常是“为了……”，与这里的风险条件不符。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: After approving two applications, the panel rejected the rest as unjust to smaller firms. In this sentence, the rest and unjust mean:
o: 休息 / 仅仅的
其余申请 / 不公正的
其余评委 / 刚刚发生的
暂停审批 / 合法的

exp.trans: 批准两份申请后，评审组以“对小企业不公平”为由拒绝了其余申请。the rest指剩下的申请；unjust表示不公正的。
exp.structure: the panel是主语，rejected是谓语，the rest是宾语；as unjust to smaller firms说明把其余申请视为何种性质。After approving...是时间背景。
exp.other: application 申请；panel 评审组；approve 批准；firm 企业。
exp.meaning: rest单独可表示休息，但the rest (of...)常表示“其余的”；just既可作副词“仅仅/刚刚”，也可作形容词“公正的”，unjust由后者加un-构成“不公正的”。
exp.rest: “休息 / 仅仅的”没有识别the rest所指的剩余申请，也误认了unjust的构词；“其余评委 / 刚刚发生的”把申请偷换成评委，且unjust不是副词just“刚刚”的否定；“暂停审批 / 合法的”既改变the rest的名词性含义，又把unjust的价值判断反转。

familiar-word-polysemy.target: dismiss A as B / address concerns
familiar-word-polysemy.skill: 熟词生义 + 固定搭配
familiar-word-polysemy.q: Officials first dismissed the complaint as trivial, but later had to address the evidence it contained. Which paraphrase is best?
o: 他们先解雇了投诉人，后来查找证据的地址。
他们起初把投诉斥为无足轻重，后来不得不处理其中的证据。
他们先证明投诉正确，后来决定忽视证据。
他们先将投诉寄出，后来改变了通信地址。

exp.trans: 官员们起初把这项投诉斥为无足轻重，但后来不得不处理其中包含的证据。
exp.structure: Officials是主语；dismissed是第一个谓语，the complaint是宾语，as trivial是宾补；but后had to address是第二个谓语结构，the evidence是宾语。
exp.other: complaint 投诉；trivial 微不足道的；evidence 证据；contain 包含。
exp.meaning: dismiss可表示“解雇”，但dismiss A as B是“把A斥为/视为B而不予重视”；address作动词可表示“处理、应对问题/担忧/证据”，不只表示地址。
exp.rest: “解雇投诉人、查找地址”把dismiss的宾语从投诉换成投诉人，并误用address的名词义；“先证明正确、后忽视证据”反转了dismiss与address在此处的意义；“寄出投诉、改变地址”虚构了邮寄行为和地址变化。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: Residents' anger over the water outage was justified: records showed that the utility had ignored repeated warnings before the pipes failed. Here justified means:
o: happening only a moment ago
expressed by an entirely impartial person
supported by adequate reasons
merely mentioned without emotion

exp.trans: 居民因停水而愤怒是有充分理由的：记录显示，自来水公司在水管故障前多次忽视警告。
exp.structure: Residents' anger是主语，was justified是系表/被动性质表达；冒号后records showed...为其理由提供证据。
exp.other: utility 公用事业公司；outage 中断；ignore warnings 忽视警告；adequate 充分的。
exp.meaning: justified通常表示有正当理由或充分依据，不应因为just也有‘仅仅’或‘公正的’就机械套进来。这里强调愤怒有依据，而不是愤怒这个情绪是否中立。
exp.rest: 刚刚发生对应just的副词用法而不是justified；完全中立并非愤怒有依据的条件；merely mentioned否定了原文的情绪与证据。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: The panel made a just decision, but the suspicion that its members had accepted bribes was not justified by the available evidence. Which distinction is correct?
o: The decision was recent; the evidence only referred to bribery.
The decision was fair; evidence did not support the suspicion.
The decision was unfair; evidence confirmed the bribery claim.
The decision expressed pride; the suspicion praised the panel.

exp.trans: 委员会作出了公正的决定，但现有证据不足以支持成员受贿的怀疑。just修饰决定时指公正；justified修饰怀疑时指是否有充分依据。
exp.structure: The panel + made + a just decision；but后the suspicion是主语，was not justified by...表示该怀疑缺乏证据支持；that从句解释怀疑的内容。
exp.other: panel 委员会；suspicion 怀疑；bribe 贿赂；available evidence 现有证据。
exp.meaning: just作为形容词可表示公正；justify动词表示证明合理/有正当理由；justified为有依据、可辩护的。它们语义相连但不能在句中任意互换。
exp.rest: recent和only误套just的其他词义；不公正且受贿已证实把两处意思都反转；pride和praise均不是这里just或justified的含义。

familiar-word-polysemy.q: At first, witnesses answered one question every ten minutes. Once the clerk combined repeated questions, the proceedings picked up pace. What changed?
o: The hearing moved through the questions faster.
The hearing switched to a more cautious schedule.
The clerk collected more questions for later use.
The witnesses were chosen at a more regular rate.

exp.trans: 起初证人每十分钟回答一题；书记员合并重复问题后，听证进程加快了。
exp.structure: Once引出时间条件；主句the proceedings是主语，picked up pace是谓语表达。速度变化属于听证进程，不属于挑选证人的频率。
exp.other: proceedings 会议或听证程序；clerk 书记员；witness 证人；pace 节奏、速度。
exp.meaning: pick up pace表示加快进程，要把pick up和pace作为整体理解，再结合减少重复问题的背景确认方向。
exp.rest: 更谨慎的日程不等于加速；收集问题把pick up误套到另一个宾语；挑选证人的频率把动作主体和对象都换掉了。

subject.target: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: 需要写一句仍适用的票务规则：“发车时间可能调整。”这里只说明可能性，不报告已经执行的处理。哪句准确？
o: Departure times were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday.
Departure times are subject to change.
Departure times are subjected to a detailed inspection every morning.
Departure times are immune to change.

exp.trans: Departure times are subject to change：发车时间可能发生调整。
exp.structure: Departure times（主语）+ are（系动词）+ subject to change（表语）。这里是规则或可能状态，不是在叙述谁已经对时刻表做了什么处理。
exp.other: departure 出发；adjustment 调整；inspection 检查；be immune to 不受……影响。
exp.meaning: be subject to在这条规则中表示可能受变化影响。be subjected to通常强调某对象被施加了某个过程。
exp.rest: were subjected to repeated adjustments yesterday：报告昨天实际经历了反复调整，时态和事件性质均不符。are subjected to a detailed inspection：说每天被施加检查过程，inspection也不是时间可能调整。are immune to change：表示不受变化影响，与题意相反。

subject.target: subject A to B / be subjected to
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q:
The cleaner deliberately subjected the curtains to a steam treatment yesterday.
要保留“昨天实际施加了处理”的含义，哪句被动改写准确？
o: The curtains are subject to changes in fashion.
The curtains were exempt from treatment yesterday.
The curtains were subjected to steam yesterday.
The curtains are suitable for steam treatment.

exp.trans: 清洁人员昨天特意对窗帘做了蒸汽处理。选项中的被动改写为：窗帘昨天受了蒸汽处理。
exp.structure: 原主干The cleaner + subjected + the curtains + to a steam treatment。被动改写将the curtains作主语，were subjected是一般过去时被动谓语，to steam说明处理内容，yesterday保留时间；施事已经明确时可省略by the cleaner。这里不是系表结构。
exp.other: cleaner 清洁人员；curtain 窗帘；deliberately 特意地；steam treatment 蒸汽处理。
exp.meaning: were subjected to steam表示窗帘昨天实际经历了蒸汽处理；关键是事件性的被动谓语，不是可能受影响或适合处理的状态。
exp.rest: are subject to changes in fashion：说窗帘可能受时尚变化影响，不是昨天被处理的事件。were exempt from treatment：免于处理，与原文相反。are suitable for steam treatment：适合做处理，只表示适宜性，不能证明处理发生过。

subject.target: be subject to / 实际事件
subject.skill: be subject to / be subjected to
subject.q: The mountain road is subject to closure during heavy snow. No closure has been announced today. Which report preserves both statements?
o: The road is reported closed after today's heavy snowfall.
Snow may close the road; no closure is reported today.
The road underwent a test involving closure earlier today.
The road is open because snow cannot lead to its closure.

exp.trans: 这条山路在大雪期间可能封闭。今天尚未宣布封路。准确报道是：大雪可能带来封路，但这两句没有报道今天已经封路。
exp.structure: The mountain road是主语，is是系动词，subject to closure表达所受约束或可能状态。第二句No closure是主语，has been announced是现在完成时被动谓语；没有公告不等于已验证现场一定开放。
exp.other: mountain road 山路；closure 封闭；announce 宣布；status 状态。
exp.meaning: be subject to可表示有可能受某变化影响，不自动表示该事件已经发生。这里也不能从“尚无公告”推出现场已确认开放。
exp.rest: 原文只报告可能受封闭影响，没有报告今天已封路；封路测试是虚构事件；未公布封路不等于已确认开放，更不能说大雪不会造成封路。

relation-collocation.target: set A apart from B / be closely tied
relation-collocation.q: The company keeps approval and sales decisions formally separate precisely because the two teams are closely tied through shared bonuses. Which reading is best?
o: 两个团队彼此没有关系，所以没有必要区分决策。
两个团队现实利益联系紧密，因此制度上反而需要刻意把两类决策分开。
shared bonuses证明销售团队已经接管审批团队。
closely tied表示两个团队被绳子绑在一起。

exp.trans: 公司之所以在制度上把审批与销售决策分开，恰恰是因为两个团队通过共同奖金存在紧密利益联系。
exp.structure: The company是主语，keeps A and B separate是谓语结构；precisely because引出原因，the two teams是主语，are closely tied是系表结构。
exp.other: approval 审批；formally 正式地/制度上；bonus 奖金；shared 共同的。
exp.meaning: set/keep A apart/separate from B表示区分；be closely tied表示紧密相关。because并不要求“原因”和“措施”表面同方向：正因为现实容易纠缠，制度上才需要分开。
exp.rest: “没有关系、不必区分”与closely tied和keeps ... separate都相反；“销售团队接管审批团队”把利益联系夸大成组织控制，shared bonuses不能证明接管；“绳子绑在一起”按字面理解比喻性的关系搭配，无法解释共同奖金带来的利益联系。

relation-collocation.skill: 关系搭配 + 反直觉因果
relation-collocation.q: The audit office is structurally independent from the ministry because its work is closely tied to decisions the ministry would otherwise judge itself. What is the logic?
o: 工作联系紧密，所以两个机构不再需要制度独立。
审计涉及该部决定，制度独立可避免自己审自己。
审计内容相关，所以审计办公室必须直属部长。
because表达转折，前后两个分句没有因果关系。

exp.trans: 审计办公室在组织上独立于该部门，因为它的工作与该部门原本可能自行评判的决定紧密相关。正因为利益和事项联系密切，制度上才需要独立。
exp.structure: The audit office是主语，is structurally independent是系表；because从句中its work是主语，is closely tied to是谓语结构，decisions是介词宾语。
exp.other: audit 审计；structurally 组织结构上；ministry 部门/部；otherwise 否则。
exp.meaning: closely tied to=与……紧密相关；independent from=独立于。文章常出现“现实联系紧密→制度上刻意分离”的治理逻辑，不能因为表面反向就否定because。
exp.rest: 联系紧密就无需独立反转了治理理由；工作内容相关不等于必须直属部长；because引出原因，不是转折。制度独立针对的是同一部门可能自己评判自己的决定。

relation-collocation.q: The repair looks like replacing one cable, but there is more to it: the technician must also find the cause of the overheating and retest the circuit. What does "there is more to it" mean here?
o: The replacement requires a longer piece of cable.
The cable costs more than the other spare parts.
It involves further work beyond changing a cable.
It creates more faults than the tests can identify.

exp.trans: 维修表面上像是换根电缆，但事情还不止这些：技师还必须查明过热原因，并重新测试电路。
exp.structure: there is more to it是完整表达；it指维修这件事。冒号后的also与并列动作find、retest说明more具体增加了哪些工作。
exp.other: overheating 过热；circuit 电路；retest 重新测试。
exp.meaning: there is more to something表示某事比表面呈现的更复杂或包含更多内容；to连接所涉及的事情，不单独表示方向。
exp.rest: 电缆更长、价格更高都没有证据；后文是查因和复测，也没有说维修新制造了更多故障。

process-stage-role.skill: 区分结果核验、消息公开与实施授权
process-stage-role.q: A hospital trial finds that a scheduling tool reduces missed appointments. The methods panel accepts the results after checking the analysis, and a staff newsletter reports the trial. Routine use must nevertheless wait for the operations board to approve a staffing plan. Which event authorises the hospital to start using the tool routinely?
o: Acceptance of the trial analysis by the methods panel.
Publication of the trial results in the staff newsletter.
The operations board's approval of the staffing plan.
The trial team's observation of fewer missed appointments.

exp.trans: 一家医院的试验发现，一种预约安排工具减少了爽约。方法审核小组检查分析后认可了结果，员工通讯也报道了这项试验。不过，常规使用仍须等待运营委员会批准人员配置计划。哪个事件授权医院开始常规使用该工具？答案是人员配置计划获批。
exp.structure: A hospital trial + finds + that从句给出试验发现；The methods panel + accepts + the results说明核验阶段。Routine use + must wait + for the operations board to approve a staffing plan说明实施仍受另一项决定约束。nevertheless连接结果已获认可与尚不能常规实施的转折。
exp.other: scheduling tool 预约安排工具；miss an appointment 爽约；methods panel 方法审核小组；staffing plan 人员配置计划；authorise 授权。
exp.meaning: 题目问开始常规实施的授权条件。独立核查在本文确实发生，却只让研究结果获得认可，不能替代运营委员会的实施批准。不能把所有过程题都机械答成独立验证。
exp.rest: 审核小组认可的是试验分析，不是常规使用的授权；员工通讯负责传播消息，没有审批权；试验团队观察到效果是提出采用建议的证据起点，仍未满足文中保留的实施条件。

process-stage-role.skill: 按提问定位过程中的决定而非总选最后一步
process-stage-role.q: A technician noticed an unusual label on a food shipment and asked a supervisor whether it should be checked. The supervisor marked the shipment 'hold', stopping dispatch. A laboratory later found the contents safe, and the quality manager signed the release form. Which event directly stopped the shipment from leaving?
o: The technician's request for advice about the label.
The supervisor's decision to put the shipment on hold.
The laboratory's conclusion that the contents were safe.
The quality manager's signature on the release form.

exp.trans: 技术员发现一批食品的标签异常，询问主管是否应检查。主管将这批货标为暂扣，停止发运。实验室后来确认货物内容安全，质量经理签署了放行单。哪个事件直接阻止了货物运出？是主管作出的暂扣决定。
exp.structure: The technician + noticed ... and asked ...是发现和上报；whether it should be checked是询问内容，其中should be checked为被动谓语。The supervisor + marked + the shipment + hold，后接stopping dispatch说明结果。found the contents safe为find加宾语和形容词补语；signed the release form属于后来的放行阶段。
exp.other: shipment 一批货物；put on hold 暂停、暂扣；dispatch 发运；release form 放行单；contents 所装物品。
exp.meaning: 先确定题目问的是停止发运，而非最早发现异常、确认安全或最终放行。直接产生停运结果的是主管的暂扣决定。过程角色题必须按问题定位阶段，不能一概选最后的正式批准。
exp.rest: 技术员询问是否检查，是上报起点，文中实际停运由主管决定；实验室认定安全发生在之后，支持解除疑虑；经理签放行单允许后续运出，与停止运出方向相反。

parallel-governance.q: Which sentence has a clean parallel structure in which the same modal verb governs both alternatives?
o: The technician can either replace the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician either can replace the sensor or recalibration of the device.
The technician can either replacing the sensor or recalibrate the device.
The technician can either replace the sensor or the device is recalibrated.

exp.trans: 正确句：技术员可以要么更换传感器，要么重新校准设备。
exp.structure: 主干：The technician（主语）+ can（情态动词）+ either replace... or recalibrate...。can同时支配replace和recalibrate，两边都是动词原形，结构完全平行。
exp.other: technician 技术员；sensor 传感器；recalibrate 重新校准；device 设备。
exp.meaning: 共同动词支配时，并列两端应保持同一语法层级。这里 can + replace / recalibrate。
exp.rest: either can replace... or recalibration... 把动词结构和名词结构并列；can either replacing... 中情态动词后不能接-ing形式；replace... or the device is recalibrated 把动词短语和完整从句并列，层级不一致。

parallel-governance.target: 共同动词支配 / 并列任务
parallel-governance.q: The inspector recommended replacing the worn belt and checking the tension before restarting the machine. Which reading preserves the recommendation?
o: The inspector reported that both jobs had already been completed.
Replacing the belt was expected to check the tension automatically.
The inspector recommended two tasks: belt replacement and a tension check.
The machine should be restarted before either task is attempted.

exp.trans: 检查员建议在重新启动机器之前更换磨损的皮带并检查张力。建议包含两项任务：更换皮带和检查张力，而不是报告它们已经完成。
exp.structure: The inspector是主语，recommended是谓语。replacing the worn belt与checking the tension是并列动名词短语，共同作recommended的补足内容；before restarting the machine给执行顺序。
exp.other: inspector 检查员；worn belt 磨损的皮带；tension 张力；restart 重新启动。
exp.meaning: and把两项动作放在同一层级，都受recommended支配。后一个动名词不是第一个动作自动产生的效果，也不是新的已完成事实。
exp.rest: had already been completed把建议改成过去已完成事实；check ... automatically把两项独立任务合成一项的自动效果；restarted before either task反转before给出的执行顺序。

text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的权力主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency says it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever the rule conflicts with its enforcement priorities. What does that claim imply?
o: It claims its enforcement power outweighs regional governments' authority.
Regional governments may override national laws whenever they disagree.
The legislature expressly banned all regional enforcement activity.
The agency accepts regional rules despite differences in enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要原本合法的地区规则与其执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称行政机构的执法权高于地区政府的权限。
exp.structure: An executive agency says that...引出机构的主张；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: executive agency 行政机构；invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；authority 权限。
exp.meaning: 题目问what does that claim imply，应概括机构声称自己拥有多大权限，而不是把这一主张误当成作者认可的法律结论。
exp.rest: 地区政府可以随意推翻国家法律是把权力方向反过来；立法机关明文禁止所有地区执法并未在句中出现；最后一项与机构声称可使冲突规则失效相反。

text4-executive-overreach.target: executive enforcement choice vs statutory local authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 行政不执行是否能取消地方依法获授的权力
text4-executive-overreach.q: A national agency declined to inspect licensed buses, then claimed towns could not carry out inspections that a statute authorized them to do. The court rejected the claim. What principle does its decision illustrate?
o: The agency may suspend towns' lawful inspections by choosing not to act.
The court rejected an attempt to block towns from exercising powers granted by law.
The towns were newly authorized to rewrite national transport standards.
The court found that national agencies alone may set all inspection dates.

exp.trans: 国家行政机构不愿检查已获许可的公交车，随后却声称法律已授权的市镇检查也不能执行。法院驳回该主张，说明行政机关自身选择不执法，不能自动取消地方依法获授的权限。
exp.structure: declined... then claimed...区分行政机关自身行为与扩张主张；a statute authorized them to do修饰inspections；The court rejected the claim给出司法回应。
exp.other: agency 行政机构；statute 成文法；authorize 授权；suspend 暂停；licensed bus 已获许可的公交车辆。
exp.meaning: 行政机关不执行某项政策与禁止地方执行是两个命题。这里法院限制的是行政部门把其执行偏好扩展成否定地方合法权限的企图。
exp.rest: 行政不作为并未赋予机构暂停合法地方执法的权力；法院未授权市镇重写国家标准；设定检查日期也不是法院本次驳回的争点。

text4-executive-overreach.target: claim about enforcement power vs legal authority
text4-executive-overreach.skill: 区分行政部门的主张与作者认可的结论
text4-executive-overreach.q: An executive agency claims it can invalidate any otherwise lawful regional rule whenever that rule conflicts with the agency's enforcement priorities. What does the agency's claim amount to?
o: Regional governments can override national laws they oppose.
Its enforcement priorities can override lawful regional rules.
The legislature prohibited regional agencies from enforcing rules.
Regional rules remain valid despite different enforcement priorities.

exp.trans: 一个行政机构声称，只要某项原本合法的地区规则与该机构的执法优先事项冲突，它就可以使该规则失效。这相当于声称，该机构的执法权高于地区政府所拥有的权限。
exp.structure: claims后面是机构主张的内容；whenever引出触发条件；otherwise lawful表示该规则在其他方面原本合法。
exp.other: invalidate 使……失效；otherwise lawful 原本合法的；enforcement priorities 执法优先事项；outweigh 权重或重要性高于。
exp.meaning: 要区分被描述的主张与文章作者认可的结论。句子是在复述行政机构想要的权力范围，并不代表作者认为这种主张正确。
exp.rest: 地区推翻国家法律反转了主张中的权力方向；立法机关禁止地方执法没有文本依据；机构声称可使规则失效，并非承认优先事项不同时规则仍有效。
